description: A live health check of your active marketplace listings, read from the marketplace (cached up to 5 minutes): each listing's price (in its own currency) against the SlabLineage price (USD), percentVsSl (whole percent above + or below -, null when it can't be compared), priceVsSl (priced_high, in_range, under_sl or no_sl_price), watchers, bids, days live and attentionReasons (priced_high: more than 10% over; no_watchers: none after 7+ days). Listings not matched to a SlabLineage card have no SL price. Different from my_listings, which reads SlabLineage's own records with no live call. Needs-attention listings at the top, up to 50; the summary counts them all.

onlyNeedsAttention.description: Return just the listings that need attention (default false).

name: listing_checkup
title: Listing check-up
